patient_identity.statement: Male Patient162 matches, but packet last-encounter age7 is the IQ assessment age. Clinical examination is at11 years.

genotype.statement: c.4405dup and p.Met1469fs match a de novo heterozygous SETD2 frameshift. Source NM_014159.6/GRCh37 differs from packet NM_014159.7/GRCh38; expanded AsnfsTer6 and coordinate normalization unverified.

segregation.statement: Family-based sequencing identifies de novo SETD2 variant; nonconsanguineous parents and no family developmental history reported.

evidence.locator: Supplement19 p20, SETD2 Patient162; FigureS7 p7; main pp3,5–7

phase.statement: Single de novo heterozygous allele; no multi-allele phase required.

causal_confidence.statement: Phenotype and de novo SETD2 variant support source attribution, but SETD2 falls short of corrected statistical significance here. Luscan-Lumish label, formal PATHOGENIC/SOLVED and exact disease-onset ontology are stronger/more formal than paper.

evidence.locator: Supplement19 p20, SETD2 Patient162; FigureS7 p7; main pp3,5–7

limitations: No variant-specific functional assay or explicit ACMG classification; literature-consistent proposed association.
